plan.understanding: Make the whistle symmetric by removing the 5 mm rear-side step, replace every existing chamfer and radius with sharp geometry, then round the two narrow-to-large transition edges to R20 mm and the remaining exterior edges to R5 mm.

subtasks.goal: Move the protruding planar surface face #34 from Z=-450.0 mm to Z=-445.0 mm so it is coplanar with adjacent planar surface face #12 at Z=-445.0 mm; preserve the rest of the whistle and verify that the resulting minimum Z is -445.0 mm rather than -450.0 mm.

Remove the imported solid’s existing exterior edge treatments by explicit boundary-shell reconstruction, without booleans, half-space tools, automatic defeaturing, or delete-and-heal. First build face adjacency from the unchanged solid and protect the full 360-degree cylindrical bore of radius 14.1421 mm, axis parallel to world X, centered at Y=270 mm and Z=-400 mm over X=100..300 mm, together with every face reachable inward through the measured blind opening loops on the planes at Y=230 mm and X=300 mm. Classify a face as an exterior blend or bevel only when it is on the outside boundary and bridges two or three exterior support surfaces; do not classify from surface type alone. The measured candidate signatures are the partial exterior cylinders R30 mm with sweeps 56.4–99.6 degrees, R35 mm with 65-degree sweep, R10 mm and R5 mm with 90-degree sweep, the R2.5 mm 90-degree corner near [299.086,251.114,-390.457], the exterior cones near [249.416,238.592,-442.406] and [249.416,238.592,-342.594], the sphere near [13.433,213.433,-432.5], the BSPLINE corner patches near [8.539,308.268,-437.770] and [88.268,208.538,-437.769], and planar bevel strips having oblique normals including [0,-0.707,-0.707], [0,-0.707,0.707], and [0.707,0,-0.707]. For each confirmed two-support treatment, copy and parametrically extend the two underlying support surfaces, calculate their exact intersection curve, retrim both support faces to that curve, and replace the blend or bevel plus its old trims with the two reconstructed face patches. For each confirmed trihedral treatment, intersect the three extended support surfaces, retrim them to the three resulting intersection curves and common vertex, and replace the spherical or BSPLINE corner patch. Perform replacements as shell operations, preserving all unaffected original faces, then sew the explicitly bounded replacement shell and validate it as one solid. Reject any replacement whose boundary is not wholly coincident with the original local face neighborhood or whose result changes the measured outer bbox X=0..300, Y=200..320, Z=-445..-340 mm. The completed intermediate solid must have sharp support-surface intersections at every confirmed former exterior blend or bevel, while the protected bore, blind-opening loops, cavity faces, connected-solid count, and outer envelope remain unchanged.

Apply R20 mm fillets to only the two symmetry-related exterior transition edges where the narrow body meets the larger head at the measured X=100 mm junction. Select these edges geometrically after shell reconstruction: they are the two sharp exterior intersections at the narrow-to-large transition, parallel to world Z and located on opposite sides of the now-symmetric body. Do not use the former source-face identifiers near X=8..13 mm, because those measured spherical and BSPLINE patches are not at the X=100 mm transition. Create both fillets at the customer-specified radius of exactly 20.0 mm, preserve the bore and opening geometry, and verify that the two resulting cylindrical fillet surfaces are symmetry counterparts.

Apply fillets of exactly R5 mm to every remaining eligible exterior sharp edge after excluding the two R20 transition edges at X=100 mm. Select edges from the reconstructed exterior-shell adjacency rather than obsolete face numbers, and exclude the circular rims and internal edges belonging to the protected radius-14.1421 mm X-axis bore and the measured blind opening loops on the Y=230 mm and X=300 mm planar faces. Process connected edge chains in topology-compatible groups, validating after each group, until every exterior edge treatment is R20 only at the narrow-to-large junction and R5 elsewhere.
